description:
DLA Aviation Richmond intends to issue a solicitation for Screws and nuts Parts with contract completion required in 90 days ARO.

Complete technical data package DLA-A-VICA 26-65-1095 including Screws and Nuts per spreadsheet and Shipping will be included as a part of the solicitation.

Request for Proposal SPE4A8-26-Q-0031 is anticipated to issue on April 13, 2026, and close on May 13, 2026

FOB will be at Destination/ Inspection and Acceptance at Destination. The solicitation will be 100% small business set aside.

Award will be the result in a Firm, Fixed Price Contract.

Please mail the solicitation package along with the compliance statement and descriptive literature.

This solicitation and award will be made under FAR 13.5 procedures.

A copy of the solicitation will be available via the DLA DIBBS website at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil/Solicitations/

Solicitations are in Portable Document Format (PDF).  To download and view these documents, use the latest version of Adobe Acrobat Reader.  This software is available free at http://www.adobe.com.  A paper or e-mail copy of the solicitation may be provided to requestors on a case-by-case basis if access to DIBBS is not available.”
